verses.text: Praise the LORD! I’ll thank the LORD with my whole heart, in the circle of the upright and in the full gathering.
The LORD’s works are great. Everyone who takes joy in them keeps thinking about them.
What he does is full of honor and majesty. His righteousness lasts forever.
He’s made sure people remember his wonders. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
He’s fed those who fear him. He never forgets his covenant.
He showed his people the power of what he does when he gave them the nations’ lands as their inheritance.
What his hands do is true and just. Every instruction he gives stands firm.
His instructions are set in place forever, carried out in truth and integrity.
He sent rescue to his people and established his covenant forever. His name is holy and fills us with awe!
Wisdom starts with the fear of the LORD. Everyone who follows his ways gains sound understanding. His praise goes on forever!
